context: The term 'Master System' is ambiguous: it is used as the product name (master_system_version, DOCS) and simultaneously exists as an empty folder MASTER SYSTEM/. The roadmap closed the decision that SYSTEM-ENGINEERING is the master source and MASTER SYSTEM is the versioned distribution layer. The reference implementation (SCRIPTS/se.py) and projects must know which distribution version they conform to.
problem: How should the versioned distribution layer be structured so projects can pin a stable Master System version without absorbing the source, and without ambiguity between the product name and the folder?

options_considered.option: MASTER SYSTEM as a pinned distribution layer
pros: Projects fix PROJECT.json.master_system_version against a frozen snapshot
Can bundle adapters and conformance evidence per release
cons: Adds a layer that must be generated/published
Needs a publish step to keep it in sync with the source

options_considered.option: Remove the folder, version only in SYSTEM.json/VERSION
cons: No canonical home for adapters/conformance per release

options_considered.option: Per-project installed copy of MASTER SYSTEM

decision: Treat MASTER SYSTEM/ as the pinned distribution layer. It contains a MANIFEST.json (schema_version, master_system_version, source reference, adapter bundles, conformance state), VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, adapters/, and conformance/. The source of truth remains SYSTEM-ENGINEERING; the distribution is a frozen, versioned snapshot consumed by projects via se install.
reason: It resolves the naming/product ambiguity, gives projects a stable version anchor (PROJECT.json.master_system_version), co-locates adapter bundles and conformance evidence per release, and preserves a single source of truth.
consequences: MASTER SYSTEM must be (re)generated on release via the SE engine (future se publish). Projects pin master_system_version; se doctor alerts on mismatch. No project copies CORE/SCHEMAS into itself.
author: principal-architect
